statement: Unify outcome and proof input_ref hash bases in the bundle
evidence: Within one bundle outcome, outcome.input_ref is canonical_input_hash(Website model) (e.g. 37de1428…) while source_proof.input_ref and every observation's input_ref are canonical_input_hash(url string) (ab64b5ed…), because scrape_websites→_scan_occurrences hashes the typed source object while admit_fetch/extract_observations hash the URL value. A consumer joining outcomes to observations or proofs by input_ref gets zero matches and must fall back to key/occurrence_id; release_smoke verify only cross-checks observation↔proof (same basis) so it never detects the divergence. Attribution itself remains correct and each basis is deterministic; impact is consumer confusion and a dead join key, observed empirically on c01/bundle.json at 907e94da.
provenance: Present at audited main; introduction not independently established
release_disposition: Observation; not remediated by this audit

evidence: ScrapeOptions.request_timeout feeds allocation.elapsed_seconds, which execute_fetch uses both as the per-request httpx timeout and as the overall waiter deadline, and execute_fetch_with_source_proof extends to the capture phase. A serialized batch (3×750ms fixtures, --max-concurrency 1, --request-timeout 2) returned failure/timeout for all inputs including fetches that had already completed under the per-request budget, because deadline expiry during capture retroactively replaces completed-but-uncaptured successes with typed timeouts. Behavior is conservative (no false success, resources retained) but the flag name and README imply per-request semantics, so large or serialized batches fail unexpectedly at the default 10s.
provenance: Present at audited main; introduction not independently established
release_disposition: Observation; not remediated by this audit

evidence: release_smoke.py run with a relative --work-dir fails during build_and_install: uv export runs with cwd=source while -o receives the still-relative requirements path, so the subsequent uv pip install reports "File not found: ../smoke/work/requirements.txt" and the harness exits 3 without running any case. Reproduced at 907e94da with --work-dir ../smoke/work; an absolute path works. DEF-24's documented command does not require an absolute path, so a reviewer following it can misread the gate as broken.
provenance: Present at audited main; introduction not independently established
release_disposition: Observation; not remediated by this audit

statement: Byte cap charge-then-check allows one-chunk overshoot
evidence: _Ledger.charge_bytes adds the chunk size before testing the limits, so a response streamed without Content-Length is read up to one transport chunk past max_bytes_per_input before body_too_large is returned: a 2MiB chunked stream against the 1,048,576-byte default was charged 1,081,291 bytes. The outcome stays a typed failure, the overshoot is bounded by a single chunk and is honestly reported in resources.bytes, so this is informational: actual reads can slightly exceed the advertised cap.
provenance: Present at audited main; introduction not independently established
release_disposition: Observation; not remediated by this audit

statement: verify without --python accepts edited report prose
evidence: release_smoke.py verify validates bundle/jsonl/artifact integrity but only re-renders report.md when --python is supplied; a copy of a good bundle whose report.md was edited to read "verified contacts" still prints VALID in the no-render mode. The tool explicitly prints this limitation and the machine bundle remains tamper-evident (the same edit is caught with --python), so this is informational: consumers of report.md alone should be pointed at the rendered-verification mode.
provenance: Present at audited main; introduction not independently established
release_disposition: Observation; not remediated by this audit

statement: No P1 release-wide rollback procedure or versioned release manifest exists yet
evidence: Every child packet has its own recovery/revert notes (DEF-41 release.md:65-71; DEF-42 manifest.json:20 + recovery/; DEF-43 'revert the two implementation commits together'; DEF-44/45/46/47/48/90 recovery.md), and DEF-48 recovery.md:13-19 covers the harness plus its stacked-branch base. statement: Enabled-capability manifest is distributed across artifacts, not a single named manifest
evidence: PRD §19.6 (prd-v3.md:681) requires each release to include 'an explicit input/output example, one successful case, one honest failure case, the enabled capability manifest and relevant test evidence'. In substance all exist: docs/audits/DEF-48/examples/batch/{bundle.json,outcomes.jsonl,report.md} contain explicit inputs/outputs, five successes, a duplicate-URL distinct snapshot, and an honest typed failure ('failure — failure: http_error', no source proof; report.md:69-80); DEF-48/packet.json:22-27 carries machine capability flags (graph/model/browser/network all false); docs/release/p1-release-checklist.md:43-53 explicitly lists disabled/deferred capabilities with milestones, S1-S8 define the enabled path, and lines 55-69 state unverified-claim boundaries. No single artifact named as the P1 enabled-capability manifest exists; the positive 'enabled' set must be assembled from the checklist plus the packet flags.
provenance: Present at audited main; introduction not independently established
release_disposition: Observation; not remediated by this audit

statement: Hunt/Doctor coverage is N/A-or-degraded for every child; disclosed, never promoted to PASS
evidence: Across DEF-23, DEF-41..48 and DEF-90, pip3r Hunt probes a CLI (no Python route; 'no CLI probe target' / zero commands) and Doctor executes no Python tests; every packet records these as UNKNOWN/BLOCKED/DEGRADED/N-A and none relabels them PASS (e.g. DEF-41 release.md:59-60; DEF-105 scope-plan.md:47-55; DEF-48/DEF-90 validator limitation results: pre-doctor-hunt BLOCKED, post-doctor-hunt DEGRADED). This is a residual, honestly-disclosed tooling limitation of the whole P1 evidence base, compensated by test/runtime/consumer evidence; it should be carried into the DEF-24 release record as residual debt rather than closed silently. Additionally the only skipped test across the four packages is api tests/e2e/test_gate0_contract.py:24, env-gated with an explicit reason.
